author: 4xforfun
notes_extra: Double ladder in .3 increments from 38 - 41.3 with the 140 BT and H4350. The same post seats the 140 LRBT. On May 21 he wrote Berger 140 LRBT's and H 4350, ran the two ladders, and the agg was right at 2 inches at 750 yards. That is group size, not velocity. He did not restate the cartridge on the ladder post; his opening post in the thread is 6.5-47L.
